sal.basis: Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, 8 yrs, Tripoli, at a large employer (NOC company or JV, large bank, multinational): estimated about 4,500 LYD gross a month. This is a low-confidence estimate made without live sources this run (see LY.sources.md): state banks and NOC companies raised pay in 2022-2024, public-sector finance staff earn much less (about 1,500-2,500 LYD) and oil JVs, multinationals and international organisations more. f = 4,500 / 26,000 = 0.173, so Noura's 26,000 becomes about 4,500 LYD now and 34,000 becomes about 5,880 LYD expected. Libyan pay is quoted monthly and often net.

autoText.en: Libyan citizens can work in Libya without a work permit.
autoText.ar: يمكن للمواطنين الليبيين العمل في ليبيا دون إذن عمل.
autoText.fr: Les citoyens libyens peuvent travailler en Libye sans permis de travail.

rule.en: If you need a work permit, we focus on employers that hire foreign staff (oil and gas, international companies and organisations) and skip jobs open to Libyans only.
rule.ar: إذا كنت تحتاج إلى إذن عمل، نركّز على أصحاب العمل الذين يوظّفون أجانب (قطاع النفط والغاز والشركات والمنظمات الدولية) ونستبعد الوظائف المخصّصة لليبيين فقط.
rule.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'un permis de travail, nous ciblons les employeurs qui recrutent des étrangers (pétrole et gaz, entreprises et organisations internationales) et écartons les offres réservées aux Libyens.

desc.en: Employers can hire a foreigner only when no qualified Libyan is available, and need a Ministry of Labour work permit; oil-sector companies are expected to train and promote Libyans, and permanent public-sector posts are for Libyan citizens.
desc.ar: لا يجوز لصاحب العمل توظيف أجنبي إلا عند عدم توفّر مواطن ليبي مؤهّل، وبعد الحصول على إذن عمل من وزارة العمل، ويُنتظر من شركات قطاع النفط تدريب الليبيين وترقيتهم، أما الوظائف الدائمة في القطاع العام فهي للمواطنين الليبيين.
desc.fr: Un employeur ne peut recruter un étranger que si aucun Libyen qualifié n'est disponible, et doit obtenir un permis de travail du ministère du Travail ; les compagnies du secteur pétrolier sont censées former et promouvoir des Libyens, et les postes permanents du secteur public sont réservés aux citoyens libyens.

sensitive.notes: Libyan CVs normally carry a photo and a personal-details block (date of birth, nationality, often marital status), and application forms at state companies, banks and NOC subsidiaries ask for gender, date of birth, nationality and the national number. Libya has no general anti-discrimination or data protection law, so we follow local norms for photo, gender, date of birth and nationality (nationality also drives work-permit logic). Marital status is common on CVs but is not needed to apply and is a bias risk, especially for women, so we do not ask (conservative). Not verified live this run; see LY.sources.md.

legal.law: No dedicated personal data protection law (privacy of private life under the 2011 Constitutional Declaration; Electronic Transactions Law No. 6 of 2022, to be verified). We apply GDPR-level standards.

privacy.en: Libya has no dedicated data protection law yet, so we protect your data to GDPR-level standards and never share it without your consent.
privacy.ar: لا يوجد في ليبيا حتى الآن قانون خاص بحماية البيانات الشخصية، لذلك نحمي بياناتك وفق معايير مماثلة للائحة الأوروبية العامة لحماية البيانات (GDPR)، ولا نشاركها دون موافقتك.
privacy.fr: La Libye ne dispose pas encore d'une loi dédiée à la protection des données ; nous protégeons donc vos données selon des standards équivalents au RGPD et ne les partageons jamais sans votre accord.

renewal.en: Your plan renews automatically at the end of each term at the price shown until you cancel. Cancel anytime in Settings before the renewal date and you won't be charged again.
renewal.ar: يتجدّد اشتراكك تلقائياً في نهاية كل فترة بالسعر المعروض إلى أن تلغيه. يمكنك الإلغاء في أي وقت من الإعدادات قبل تاريخ التجديد، ولن يُخصم منك أي مبلغ بعد ذلك.
renewal.fr: Votre abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement à la fin de chaque période, au prix indiqué, jusqu'à résiliation. Résiliez à tout moment dans les Paramètres avant la date de renouvellement et vous ne serez plus prélevé.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Tripoli. I lead budgeting and IFRS reporting on SAP across business units, alongside local statutory accounts, and own the monthly close for a 30-person finance function. I build Power BI dashboards that help management track costs, cash and foreign-currency exposure.
bio.ar: محللة مالية بخبرة 8 سنوات في طرابلس. أقود إعداد الميزانيات والتقارير المالية وفق المعايير الدولية IFRS على نظام SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، إلى جانب القوائم المالية النظامية المحلية، وأتولى الإقفال الشهري لإدارة مالية تضم 30 موظفاً. أبني لوحات Power BI تساعد الإدارة على متابعة التكاليف والسيولة والتعرّض لمخاطر العملات الأجنبية.
bio.fr: Analyste financière avec 8 ans d'expérience à Tripoli. Je pilote le budget et le reporting IFRS sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, en parallèle des comptes statutaires locaux, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une fonction finance de 30 personnes. Je conçois des tableaux de bord Power BI qui aident la direction à suivre les coûts, la trésorerie et l'exposition au risque de change.

culture.notes: Work week Sunday to Thursday (Friday-Saturday weekend); public-sector hours are roughly 8:00-14:00 or 15:00, shorter in Ramadan. Pay is discussed per month, usually net, and paid monthly by bank transfer; public-sector salaries are sometimes paid late, and recurring cash shortages at banks make card and transfer payments matter. Pay differs sharply by employer type: oil companies and JVs, multinationals and international organisations pay well above state ministries. CVs: Arabic for state bodies, banks and local firms, English for oil and gas, multinationals and INGOs/UN; 2 pages, usually with a photo and personal details (date of birth, nationality, often marital status); application forms ask for the national number. Cover letters are rare except at international organisations, which expect a motivation letter and their own forms. Referrals and personal networks matter, and many vacancies circulate on Facebook pages and groups as well as boards. English proficiency is a key screening point in oil and gas. Notice: about one month is the norm for monthly-paid staff (to be verified against Labour Relations Law No. 12 of 2010); managers may agree longer by contract.
